cases.disposition_reason: jackin --scenario hard-cases --color truecolor --motion reduced at 120×40, then first-use. Shell keys c and u are JackinCmd::Accounts and JackinCmd::Usage in src/bin/jackin/app.rs and pass select: None. Accounts key m is Go::Usage { select } in src/bin/jackin/screens/accounts.rs. Usage key m is Go::Accounts { select: self.selected } in src/bin/jackin/screens/usage.rs, so the same account stays selected. Esc or q from the list is Go::Manager; from the detail it returns to the list. Key r calls UsageScreen::refresh. Zero accounts, and a second r while every enabled account is already Refreshing, paint Nothing to refresh. A started refresh paints Reloading the broker projection · N account(s). UsageScreen::on_msg does not read World::refresh_fails. world_for(HardCases) in src/bin/jackin/domain/fixtures.rs sets refresh_fails, and AccountsScreen::apply_refresh in src/bin/jackin/screens/accounts.rs is the handler that would paint Usage broker unreachable: last good values kept. on_msg returns Outcome::Changed and sets Freshness::Failed only when the existing issue code is RateLimited, ProviderUnavailable, or CredentialFileMissing, keeping last_good_secs and the quota windows. Go stays at 57%, 45%, and 22% with Rate limited: retry after 25 min. Stale Work becomes · current · and keeps 76%. MiniMax keeps 8% and 47%. Credential lines use source.safe_detail() from src/bin/jackin/domain/account.rs through src/bin/jackin/screens/usage.rs. The plaintext secrets in src/bin/jackin/sim/onepassword.rs are not painted. Ctrl is not required; the route returns to the manager or to the same account.
cases.entry_path: jackin --scenario hard-cases --color truecolor --motion reduced at 120x40; c, then m. Shell u from the manager. first-use for zero accounts.
cases.return_path: m returns to Accounts with the same account selected. Esc or q from the list returns to the manager.

cases.disposition_reason: jackin --scenario accounts-mixed --color truecolor --motion reduced at 120×40. acct-codex-experiments is created with FreshnessInfo::refreshing in src/bin/jackin/domain/fixtures.rs, and UsageScreen::refresh in src/bin/jackin/screens/usage.rs skips an account that is already Refreshing, so that row never leaves the spinner. The shot removes it on Accounts so on_tick can paint broker · 1 min ago. The checkpoint is the open Go detail after r and before m: Status is available · error: Rate limited: retry after 25 min, windows stay 57%, 45%, and 22% (resets in 1 h 48 min), and Last good is kept from 3 h ago. The painted stale line is stale · last good 47 min ago, the usage detail, not the issue string Usage stale · last good 47 min ago. Missing is No credential found: ~/.kimi. After refresh, Work is · current · at 76%. That success is accounts-mixed, where refresh_fails is false. The failed Go frame is the issue-code path in UsageScreen::on_msg, which ignores refresh_fails, so the same last-good numbers remain where world_for(HardCases) sets refresh_fails. Usage broker unreachable is not painted. A second r paints Nothing to refresh while rows are still refreshing. Enter opens the detail. Narrow is resize(80, 24) before resize(120, 40). m returns to Accounts › OpenCode › Go subscription with Go subscription focused and 57% still shown. Credential text is safe_detail from src/bin/jackin/domain/account.rs. No raw secret from src/bin/jackin/sim/onepassword.rs is painted, and 38% or 76% is not painted on the Go frame.
cases.action_sequence: Open each usage view. Show quota, missing data, mixed health, freshness, and stale values. Start refresh, refuse a duplicate, succeed, and fail.
cases.expected_results: Failure keeps the last good numbers. Return opens the same account.
cases.forbidden_effects: Failed refresh replaces the numbers with another account's quota.
